individual_reviews.title: Not satisfied with this college.

content.Placements: The placement drive in this college is very bad and misleading. They make fools every time. If you want placements, then go to another college. No big company visits to give opportunities in this college. The placement cell is too distracting and boring as well.
content.Infrastructure: Bad experience and irritating Wi-Fi. Not available for students. Labs are available but the infrastructure is very poor, like a government school. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Lloyd is good college if you are disciplined.

content.Placements: As of now, around 50 students have been placed from our final year, and one final semester is still left. Most of the internships are also paid, and students get PPO as well, so it's not the best but still good. Other than that, there is rigorous training and placement activities going on.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi equipped classrooms are there, and each Wi-Fi has a capacity of 80 connections, which sometimes fails due to overload. Classrooms and library are huge and well-equipped with almost everything required like SMART boards, comfortable seats, and air conditioning in almost every classroom.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: LIET has good infrastructure and academics.

content.Placements: From semester 6, students are eligible for placements. Many companies like TCS, Cisco, IBM, Paytm, and many more visit for placements here. Almost 75% of students who are eligible for placement get placed. Last year, the highest placement was 18 LPA, and the average package ranges between 4–7 LPA. Students with more than 7 CGPA in the 3rd year almost get placed.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel food is decent, and other facilities are good, but private hostels nearby do not provide better facilities. If you take the hostel provided by the college, its facilities are top-notch. The food is very good. Lunch is provided on time, and complaints are resolved within 36 hours.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good placement and supportive faculty. Great exposure, decent campus life.

content.Placements: Lloyd College offers strong placement with 80-90% students. The average package is around 4-6 LPA, with top recruiters like Deloitte, KMPG, TCS, ICICI, and HDFC. Students also get good internships and roles in marketing, finance, HR, and operations.
content.Infrastructure: The course offers good Wi-Fi, a smart classroom, well-equipped labs, and a helpful library. Hostel facility are decent with clean room, basic amenities, okay food in the mess and canteen, and access to medical help, sports and in-door games also have a good areas.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Very good for admission for students who seriously want to study in B.Tech, BBA, BCA, and MCA.

content.Placements: My batch began last year, and now we have moved to the second year. As I got to know, this year, the first batch of Lloyd Institute of Engineering and Technology got placed with good placements, and the salary of the students is 6-12 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The college has well-equipped labs and very helpful and supportive faculty members. Teachers support students not only in academic issues but also in other problems.
